visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A person wearing a white t-shirt and a dark apron walks into a brightly lit, modest restaurant. The interior features white walls adorned with framed floral artwork and simple tables where customers are seated. (2) Close-up shots display raw ingredients including fresh oysters, pink fish slices, and various bivalve clams on a metal tray. A bowl of orange-colored cooked shrimp is also visible. (3) Hands use a black paddle to scoop white rice from a large commercial rice cooker into a small bowl. A person in a blue shirt pours clear, steaming hot broth from a small metal pot into a bowl containing ingredients. (4) The camera focuses on the finished 'Grandpa's ancestral soup rice' dish, showing shrimp, clams, bamboo shoots, and minced pork in a light broth. A spoon lifts a portion of rice and bamboo shoots. (5) Another dish, sesame oil pork noodles, is featured. Dark brown oil droplets float on the surface of the broth. A pair of chopsticks lifts thin white noodles from the bowl. (6) A three-tiered serving stand displays small plates of boiled seafood: squid slices, whole shrimp, and open clams. (7) Finally, the camera shows the exterior entrance of the shop where a man in a mask and a woman in a floral dress stand behind a wooden counter, smiling and gesturing towards the viewer. Yellow text and location details appear as a graphic overlay.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 在地人默默吃. (2) [Subtitle]: 10年的湯泡飯. (3) [Subtitle]: 是老闆與家人一起經營的小店. (4) [Subtitle]: 每天親自挑選新鮮食材. (5) [Subtitle]: 搭配花東壽司米. (6) [Subtitle]: 費時熬煮的高湯. (7) [Subtitle]: 一定要點祖傳湯泡飯. (8) [Subtitle]: 是傳承阿嬤手路的家常味. (9) [Subtitle]: 米飯吸飽湯汁加上筍絲清香甘醇. (10) [Subtitle]: 吃得到鮮蝦 蛤蜊 旗魚塊. (11) [Subtitle]: 如果想吃更澎湃. [Subtitle]: 推薦鮮味海產泡飯. (12) [Subtitle]: 蝦子 蚵仔 旗魚片 蛤蜊通通有. (13) [Subtitle]: 他們家的麻油豬肉麵線也很熱門. (14) [Subtitle]: 純黑芝麻精釀的麻油. (15) [Subtitle]: 香氣濃郁卻不燥熱. [Subtitle]: 夏天吃也很剛好. (16) [Subtitle]: 還有燙的海鮮盤. [Subtitle]: 每樣都超新鮮. (17) [Subtitle]: 喜歡湯泡飯快來試試. [Subtitle]: 內用有冷氣哦. (18) [Slogan]: 一碗贊樓 高雄市三民區泰安街22號. [Subtitle]: 我們是虎麗笑嗨嗨. [Subtitle]: 下次再一起吃美食囉.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a promotional restaurant review intended to attract food enthusiasts to '一碗贊樓' in Kaohsiung. It emphasizes the restaurant's ten-year history, family-run nature, and the freshness of its seafood rice soup and sesame oil noodles. By combining sensory visual close-ups of steaming food with a friendly narration, it creates an inviting atmosphere of local home-cooked comfort.
